svg.text: Five cold-atom traces: clock readings and recurrence
Each series normalized separately to [0,1] within its trace; central values, no smoothing or error bars.
The path curve uses chronological position increments; its monotonicity is constructed, not an independent discovery of time.
Data: Giovanni Barontini, Zenodo v1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19651064 (2026), CC BY 4.0. Analysis: this repository.
Order half-band is an interval-feasibility diagnostic, not a statistical confidence level.
